cues: The reactions of copper sulphate solution are examined every year.
Sodium hydroxide gives a blue gelatinous precipitate of copper hydroxide.
A little ammonia gives the same, but excess ammonia dissolves it to the deep blue tetrammine complex.
Hydrogen sulphide gives black copper sulphide.
